note: Animals, step B (Radar; Steve-approved plan 2026-10-21, design items/ANIMALS_DESIGN.md): one species, the rabbit. Server-owned records, no physics; they walk with the shared steering module (src/shared/steering.gd). Each player keeps up to target_per_player of a species within active_radius_m; new ones appear spawn_min_m to spawn_max_m from the player (out of sight) and never within never_within_m of any player; none are saved. Beyond active_radius_m from every player an animal is frozen (not ticked); beyond despawn_m it is dropped. Tick rates by distance to the nearest player: hz_near within near_m, hz_mid within mid_m, hz_far beyond. AI work per server tick is capped at tick_budget_ms (a quarter of the animals are looked at each tick, the rest wait). Caps: per_player_cap animals counted near one player, server_cap in all. Rabbit: grazes, hops a few metres, bolts away from a player within spook_m until safe_m, then settles. No hunting yet (damage and carcass come next). Deer (species 2, build 478): live in herds of 3 to 6; when one bolts the others follow after alarm_s seconds (the first to see a player is the sentinel). Health 20: three spear jabs. Build 480 (Tyler report 16): an animal that notices a player within alert_m (but not yet spook_m) freezes and watches for alert_s, then relaxes or bolts; a bolt zigzags (zig_deg every zig_leg_m), sprints for burst_s and then trots at trot_share of the sprint speed; herd members that stray beyond herd_pull_m graze back toward the herd centre. Build 492: senses block. A player is perceived at distance / factor: downwind of the player (the wind carries scent to the animal) factor up to 1 + scent_gain x wind, upwind down to 0.5; crouch 0.6, sit 0.8, lying 0.5; with terrain between the animal's eye and the player (sampled every los_step_m) and the player beyond always_notice_m the factor is multiplied by blind_factor. Rabbits own a burrow (their spawn spot): a bolt within burrow_m and away from the threat runs for it, the rabbit goes to ground for hide_s and is neither sent nor huntable until it comes out. Blood trail (build 493): a wounded animal drops blood every every_m while it runs (at most max_drops each, max_total on the map, dry after life_s seconds); the server sends the drops near each player as protocol 55 blood points. Habitat (build 495): a new animal tries habitat_tries spots; a spot is refused when steeper than slope_max (rise over run_m in four directions), more than above_player_m higher than the player, or within water_edge_m of deep water; a deer prefers a spot under trees when tree data is loaded there. Forest sight: a line of sight under tree crowns loses up to forest_block of its visibility (trees do not fully block it). Bleeding out (build 508): a wounded animal loses blood.bleed_hp_per_s health a second and dies where it is when it runs out (the carcass lies at the end of its trail; a deer hit once for 8 of its 20 health has about 80 s), so a hunter can follow the drops to it. Wolves (build 509, items/WOLF_CARD.md decisions): species wolf is a pack animal (pack_size); server_wolves.gd owns its brain and the wolves block here is every number. natural false = admin spawn only until Dave wants wild packs (one home per cell_m square, cell_share of cells, respawn_s after a wipe, never inside exclude [x, z, radius]).

flight.note: Single birds in flight, step 1 (docs/design/bird_flight_server_design.md; MikeW's client layer): a species row with a flight block flies when it bolts. flush: sits tight to flush_m, bursts up climb_m in burst_s, flies fly_m at fly_mps bending to cover, glides the last glide_share down, lands and runs run_m. perch: flies to tree cover fly_m off and sits perch_up_m up for perch_s, then comes down once nobody is within safe_m. Every flight stays clear_m over the ground except where it lands. Wire: 15 flying, 17 gliding.

dogs.note: A player's companion dog as a presence for wild animals (dog_companion_design.md 11; MikeW, docs/design/DOG_REACTIONS.md): species rows with a dog block react to it; a dog that barked within bark_s is sensed bark_x farther.

weather.note: Steve 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/animals_in_weather_design.md, step 1; research docs/knowledge/animals-in-weather.md, Jamie): weather tilts behaviour by a species row's weather role (deer, stock, small, bird, hunter). Wind: jumpy roles spook and alert up to wind_spook_max times farther by wind_spook_at; small animals lose small_wind_cut of their activity above small_wind_from and small_wind_cut_high above small_wind_high, and go down their burrows that often; hunters hunt hunter_wind_x more; deer and hunters wander into the wind (upwind_share, within upwind_spread_deg) below gale_from. A storm (storm_from) or snowfall (snowfall_from) cuts activity to storm_activity_x and wander to storm_wander_x. A storm in any of ahead_hours (sampled every ahead_every_s real seconds) makes birds, small animals and deer feed ahead_feed_x more and skip their daytime rest. Mist cuts sight by mist_sight and spook by mist_spook.
weather.step2_note: Step 2 (animals_in_weather_design.md 6 and 7): in rain (rain_from) deer and stock stand out hunch_share of their grazing spells (wire state 20); deer in rain or a gale and half the stock in rain move home to tree cover within cover_m (deer in a gale with no trees: lower ground), and walk back cover_return_s real seconds (one game hour) after it passes; in a gale stock face downwind and drift at drift_mps.
weather.cover_stand_note: Design 11 (MikeW, ANIMAL_WEATHER_LOOKS.md): a deer or stock animal grazing within cover_stand_m of the cover home it moved to, or under tree crowns, is sent hunched (state 20) for as long as the rain, a gale or the cold lasts. Midday heat in the shade is not a hunch.
weather.step3_note: Step 3 (design 9): wolves in wolf_snow_from snow or more walk and trot wolf_snow.speed_x as fast and prowl wolf_snow.roam_x as far (the chase is unchanged); deer below cold_c air (seasonal temp_c less lapse_c_per_m) or in snow_cold_from snowfall move home to tree crowns in conifer_biomes, else lower ground; stock in hot_c air between heat_hours go to shade. All return cover_return_s after it passes.

nests.note: Inland bird nests (MikeW 3 Nov; eggs and seasons in data/items/nests.json, Sal): one roll per cell_m square per kind, chance x the species biome weight; grouse on open ground, songbirds under trees or bushes; never steeper than slope_max.

island_level.note: Starter island levels (Dave 6 Nov 2026, corrected 17:20): every animal has a level. Species live wherever is natural for them (biome, water, terrain); the island only sets their level. island_level is 0 within town_m of the town point (the real spawn until the starter town is placed) and 1 at far_m, about the far coast of tile 3,4. An animal's level is drawn from levels.town near the town, levels.middle half way across and levels.far on the far side (blended between). Each level above 1 adds hp_per_level to its health and damage_per_level to its hit.

ice.note: Steve 8 Nov 2026 (docs/design/animals_on_ice_server.md; Jamie docs/knowledge/animals-on-ice-and-snow.md #736; MikeW ANIMAL_WEATHER_LOOKS.md ice; Kathleen frozen_water_look.md #729). Off by default. Ice is the server's Ice.cover at 3 m (as the players'), h cm = cover x 20, open in a thaw moat, kept per 1 km band and 5 m of height for cache_s. Ice holds an animal for sure when mass_kg <= sure_k x h^2 (Jamie, Minnesota DNR; it may break up to break_k x h^2; animals keep off doubtful ice, judged). Deer-role animals and skirt_species never step on ice of skirt_cover or more (deer fall on bare ice), even in shallows they would wade; any other species in mass_kg walks on ice that holds it, at the water surface. A water flock on ice that holds it (flock_mass_kg when unlisted) stands edge_back_m back from the nearest water whose ice would not, within edge_search_m, or does not settle there. Starter ice (2.8 to 5.6 cm) holds crows, rabbits and foxes, never a wolf for sure.
ice.mass_note: Jamie #736: raven 1.2 (crow), hare 3.5 (rabbit), fox 6, wolf 40. Duck 1.1, goose 4 and seabird 1 are judged, not from the page.

wolves.dog_note: MikeW's DOG_REACTIONS.md (dog_companion_design.md 11): a pack goes for a player's dog within distract_m before any deer, and bites it dog_bite every dog_bite_s through the damage hook.

pups.note: Dave 8 Nov 2026, decisions 3 and 4 (docs/design/wolf_packs_and_pups_design.md). A natural pack made between day-of-year days[0] and days[1] has count pups at its den (sent as young, hp_x of a wolf's health). They stay within play_m of the den and play by day; a player within hide_m who stands or moves sends them into the den. A player within guard_m of the den while the pack is alive: the pack comes home and warns for warn_s, then rushes one still within rush_m, torch or not (a campfire and a second player still hold it). A killed pack's pups are orphans for orphan_days game days (the den gets no new pack meanwhile); town_keep_m: no pack den this near the town point.

temperament.note: Dave 6 Nov 2026: every animal has an inherent temperament. Passive ones hide or run at all costs; neutral ones ignore us; aggressive ones attack; some are friendly, as in the real wild. A species row's 'temperament' gives the share of each kind it is born with (none = all defensive). spook_x scales how close a player may come before it runs (0 = it never runs), threat_x scales its defend.threat_m (0 = never attacks there), attacks false = never attacks unless defending its young, alert false = it does not stop to watch. bluff_x scales a species' defend.bluff_share (how often a charge is a bluff; docs/design/bear_threat_design.md). Seasons and young change these further (species 'seasons', 'young').
